title: Tea and a Warm Cardigan  (お茶と暖かいカーディガン)

segments.t: カフェコーナーに案内されたイヴリンに、テッサは熱いミントティーと新品の柔らかいカーディガンを用意しました。グレアムも謎の青いスーツケースをしっかりと保管します。まずは心温まるやり取りを聴いてみましょう。
Here you are, ma'am: hot mint tea and honey.
Oh, thank you, Tessa. My hands were cold from the shock!
And look, this soft wool cardigan is clean and never worn. Try it on.
Are you sure? It looks lovely and warm!
It fits you very well, ma'am.
You good people are saving my whole trip.
A traveler cannot sit upstairs sad on her first evening in Portland!
I locked the other blue suitcase safely in our luggage closet.
Thank you, Graham. That little wooden train inside looked old and precious.
Whoever owns it will surely look for it soon.
I think I will sleep well tonight after all.
Rest well, ma'am. Ring down if you need anything.
それでは一文ずつ、思いやりのこもった表現を見ていきましょう。
Here you are, ma'am: hot mint tea and honey.
'さあどうぞ、お客さま。熱いミントティーとはちみつですよ。'
Oh, thank you, Tessa. My hands were cold from the shock!
'まあ、ありがとう、テッサ。驚きのあまり両手が冷たくなっていたのよ！'
And look, this soft wool cardigan is clean and never worn. Try it on.
'それにご覧になって、この柔らかいウールのカーディガンは清潔でまだ一度も袖を通していないんです。羽織ってみてください。'
Are you sure? It looks lovely and warm!
'本当にいいの？とても素敵で暖かそうだわ！'
It fits you very well, ma'am.
'とてもよくお似合いですよ、お客さま。'
You good people are saving my whole trip.
'親切なみなさんが、私の旅を丸ごと救ってくださっているわ。'
A traveler cannot sit upstairs sad on her first evening in Portland!
'ポートランドでの最初の夜に、旅のお客さまを上の階で悲しく座らせてはおけませんもの！'
I locked the other blue suitcase safely in our luggage closet.
'もう片方の青いスーツケースは、荷物用の収納室に安全に鍵をかけてしまいました。'
Thank you, Graham. That little wooden train inside looked old and precious.
'ありがとう、グレアム。中にあったあの小さな木製の列車、古くて大切な品に見えたわ。'
Whoever owns it will surely look for it soon.
'持ち主がどなたであれ、きっとすぐに探し始めるはずですよ。'
I think I will sleep well tonight after all.
'おかげさまで、今夜はやっぱりぐっすり眠れそうだわ。'
Rest well, ma'am. Ring down if you need anything.
'どうぞゆっくりお休みください、お客さま。何かご入用でしたらベルでお知らせくださいね。'
ではもう一度、穏やかな会話全体を自然な速さで聴いてみましょう。

Oh, thank you, Tessa. My hands were cold from the shock!
And look, this soft wool cardigan is clean and never worn. Try it on.
Are you sure? It looks lovely and warm!
It fits you very well, ma'am.
You good people are saving my whole trip.
A traveler cannot sit upstairs sad on her first evening in Portland!
I locked the other blue suitcase safely in our luggage closet.
Thank you, Graham. That little wooden train inside looked old and precious.
Whoever owns it will surely look for it soon.
I think I will sleep well tonight after all.
Rest well, ma'am. Ring down if you need anything.
温かいお茶とカーディガンのおかげで、イヴリンも笑顔を取り戻しました。ところがその夜遅く、静かな中庭の門で思いがけないベルが鳴り響きます。それではおやすみなさい。
Good night!
